description:
Decode template transform kinds into their enum when templates load.

## Background

`Transform.kind` is a `String` (`crates/jit/src/templates.rs:384-389`), parsed at load (`:603`) and again at apply (`commands/template_expand.rs:242-249`). `TransformKind` hand-writes `MOVE_UPSTREAM_TO_ROLE` and `SUPPORTED` (`templates.rs:167-182`), and `UnknownTransformKind` (`:139`) reports an unknown kind.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `TransformKind` is declared through the macro, and `Transform.kind` is a `TransformKind`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The hand-written constants and the apply-time check are gone.
- [hard] REQ-03: An unknown transform kind fails template loading with an error naming the template.
title: Template transform kind is typed at load
